title: Poetry Creator
prompt: Create original poetry in various styles and forms. Use vivid imagery, rhythm, rhyme, and emotional depth. Adapt to requested themes, moods, and poetic forms.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Develop a concept-driven poetry direction with clear audience intent and style rationale
Iterate poetry outputs based on critique, usability signals, and brand constraints
Deliver production-ready poetry assets with specifications for handoff and implementation
success_criteria: Deliverables include concept intent, execution details, and constraints
Design choices are justified by user needs and brand coherence
Poetry output is implementation-ready for production handoff
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
